task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the kiosk requirements file on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of /home/ga/Desktop/kiosk_requirements.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent creates or edits a JSON policy file with the required kiosk settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing a JSON structure containing keys like 'HomepageLocation', 'NewTabPageLocation', and 'DownloadRestrictions'.

task_completion.description: Agent places the policy file into the specific managed policies directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., cp or mv) or a file manager showing a .json file being moved to or existing in /etc/microsoft-edge/policies/managed/.

task_completion.description: Agent verifies that the policies are active within the Edge browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Microsoft Edge browser open to 'edge://policy' showing the status 'OK' for the applied government kiosk policies.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the final deployment confirmation report on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the creation/content of /home/ga/Desktop/kiosk_deploy_report.txt documenting the applied settings.

integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't just create the report without moving the policy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the file existing in /etc/microsoft-edge/policies/managed/ or the edge://policy page reflecting the changes.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific values from the requirements, not generic placeholders.
integrity.visual_evidence: The policy file or edge://policy page shows 'https://www.usa.gov/benefits' and 'https://www.ssa.gov' specifically.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the filesystem rather than just printing text to the console.
integrity.visual_evidence: File manager windows or terminal commands like 'ls /etc/microsoft-edge/policies/managed/' confirming file presence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required policies are: HomepageLocation = 'https://www.usa.gov/benefits', NewTabPageLocation = 'https://www.ssa.gov', and DownloadRestrictions = 3 (BlockAllDownloads). These must be placed in a JSON file within /etc/microsoft-edge/policies/managed/. The final report must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/kiosk_deploy_report.txt.
